about:
TREIF USA Inc, with its website at marel.com, is headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. The company operates as JBT Marel, a global leader in advanced automation for the food and beverage industry.

JBT Marel designs and delivers a comprehensive portfolio that spans high-performing standalone machines to fully integrated, end-to-end processing lines. Its equipment solutions cover primary processing, further processing, refrigeration, and end-of-line packaging across protein, produce, and plant-based categories. Complementing the hardware, the company provides purpose-built food processing software that integrates machine, process, and business data to enable real-time insights, traceability compliance, and preventative maintenance. A global service network — 133 locations across 29 countries — offers lifetime support through service agreements, spare parts, and on-site expertise, anchored by Customer Technology Centers such as the Lakeland Customer Innovation Center where processors can trial technologies like the Flip & Wash bin washer.

The company serves a broad spectrum of food and beverage sectors, including poultry, meat, fish and seafood, prepared foods, ready meals, beverages and juices, fruit and vegetables, plant-based products, dairy and cheese, pet food, material handling automation, pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals, and water treatment. Notable references include the adoption of Townsend skinners as a standard in the U.S. meat industry and a long-standing partnership with Marlow Foods for plant-based production.

JBT Marel positions its differentiation on the seamless integration of equipment, software, and lifetime service to help customers produce the most value from the least resources. Its automation strategy addresses labor shortages while improving food safety, and its sustainability focus targets energy and water savings, waste reduction, and better raw-material utilization. The firm emphasizes co-creation with customers through its regional technology centers to develop tailored solutions.
